HomeFares OverviewReduced Fares
Reduced Fares

Some riders are eligible for reduced fares. Military personnel, legally blind individuals and children 11 and under ride for free. 

No matter which type of reduced fare card you have, all reduced fare prices are the same.

Free Fare Eligibility
Children 11 years and younger
People who are legally blind
Riders 75 and older who do not drive
Military personnel
On-duty police and firefighters
Government officials
Riders Eligible for Reduced Fares

You can now apply online for a reduced fare card. Find your pass type below to start the application process.

Riders with disabilities and Medicare cardholders

If you’re a person with a disability or a Medicare cardholder, you may be eligible for reduced fares with a Transportation Access Pass (TAP).

Learn more about the Transportation Access Pass (TAP)

Riders 65 and older

If you are 65 or older, you are eligible for reduced fares with a Senior CharlieCard.

Learn more about the Senior CharlieCard

Some middle and high school students

If you attend one of the schools enrolled in the MBTA’s Student Pass Program, you are eligible for an S-Card or M7 Card. 

Learn more about Student Cards

Riders 18 – 64 enrolled in state assistance

If you're between the ages of 18 – 64 and are enrolled in an approved state assistance program, you may qualify for income-eligible reduced fares.

Learn more about income-eligible reduced fares

Reduced One-Way Fares

Riders enrolled in reduced fare programs can link their benefits to their contactless payment method for reduced one-way fares on bus and subway.

Learn more about linking your reduced fare card

Subway One-Way
$1.10

with reduced fare card

Bus One-Way
$0.85

with reduced fare card

Commuter Rail One-Way
$1.10 – $6.50

with CharlieTicket or mTicket App

Ferry One-Way
$1.10 – $4.85

with mTicket App, paper ferry ticket, contactless payment, or cash

ADA Ride One-Way
$1.70

With senior or income-eligible reduced fare card

Premium Ride One-Way
$2.80

With senior or income-eligible reduced fare card

Note: RIDE customers enrolled in the senior, Car-Free Seniors, or income-eligible reduced fare programs can receive discounts on ADA/standard and Premium trips.

Learn more about reduced fares on The RIDE

Fare Checks in Effect

The MBTA’s Fare Engagement department is conducting fare checks at subway stations and onboard vehicles. Riders who don’t pay their fare will be issued a warning or fare citation. Citations can cost between $50 and $150 each.

Learn more about the MBTA's Fare Check program

Transfers
Subway, Bus, and Ferry

Starting September 1, 2026, the MBTA is piloting an updated transfer policy on subway, bus, and ferry. For these modes, make an “unlimited” number of transfers within the two-hour window and pay only the cost of the highest-priced service. You must use the same form of payment between all modes for transfers to apply.

Commuter Rail

Certain monthly Commuter Rail passes printed on a CharlieTicket include unlimited transfers to any mode. Single-ride Commuter Rail and ferry tickets generally do not include free transfers.

Note: Transfers are not available with stored value CharlieTickets or cash payments. Transfer rules still apply to travel with contactless payment.

Learn more about transfers

Reduced Subway and Bus Passes

Reduced subway and bus passes can be purchased on either a CharlieCard or a CharlieTicket.

Reduced Monthly LinkPass

$30.00

Unlimited travel for the remainder of the month

CharlieCard and CharlieTicket valid on:

 Subway
 Local Bus and Express Bus
 Silver Line


CharlieTicket also valid on:

 Commuter Rail Zone 1A

Reduced 7-Day LinkPass

$10.00

Unlimited travel for seven days.

CharlieCard and CharlieTicket valid on:

 Subway
 Local Bus and Express Bus
 Silver Line


Commuter Rail Zone 1A Pass on CharlieTicket also valid on:

 Commuter Rail Zone 1A 
Reduced Commuter Rail Passes

Reduced Commuter Rail passes can be purchased on either a CharlieTicket or through the mTicket app.

How much will my reduced fare Commuter Rail pass be?

Reduced Monthly Commuter Rail Pass

$30.00 – $209.00

Unlimited travel for the remainder of the month on:

 Commuter Rail
 Local Bus and Express Bus
 Subway
 All ferries, up to and beyond designated pass zone

Reduced Monthly Commuter Rail Pass, mTicket

$30.00 – $204.00

Unlimited travel for the remainder of the month

Valid on:

 Commuter Rail, up to designated pass zone 
 Ferry, up to and beyond designated pass zone

No transfers to other modes

Reduced Monthly Hingham/Hull Ferry Pass

$164.00

Unlimited travel for the remainder of the month on:

 Ferry
 Subway
 Silver Line
 Local Bus and Express Bus
 Commuter Rail Zones 1A – 5

Reduced Monthly Hingham/Hull Ferry Pass, mTicket

$159.00

Unlimited travel for the remainder of the month on all MBTA ferry routes.

mTicket valid on:

 All MBTA ferries

Bulk Orders
College and University Passes

Colleges and universities can order discounted or subsidized passes for their students.

Student Pass Program

Middle and high schools can order passes with savings for their students.

Income-Eligible Reduced Fares

If you’re between the ages of 18 – 64 and are enrolled in a state assistance program, you may be income-eligible for reduced fares.

Learn more about income-eligible reduced fares

Need help accessing the MBTA?

The Mobility Center, located in Boston at 1000 Massachusetts Ave, can help you plan trips, apply for reduced fare passes, sign up for The RIDE, and more.

Learn more about the Mobility Center

Reduced Fares on The RIDE

If you're enrolled in the senior, Car-Free Seniors, or income-eligible reduced fare programs, you can receive discounts on ADA/standard and Premium trips with the RIDE.

Learn how to get reduced RIDE fares

Pay with Your EBT Card
Pay with Your EBT Card
You can use your Massachusetts Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) card to pay for your travel at any fare vending machine, the Charlie Service Center, or at an MBTA retail sales location that accepts EBT.

Learn more about paying with your EBT card

Small and large wall mirrors that reflect your style

With so many options to choose from—from tall wall mirrors that can be hung vertically or horizontally to smaller round mirrors—there are options for every room and space in your home. Selecting the right size and positioning of a wall mirror comes down to what kind of impact you want it to have, available space and whether the mirror will be regularly used or is primarily decorative.

What is the proper height to hang a mirror on the wall?
Small oval mirrors can create a bold style statement in entryways or foyers, stairways or the kitchen—or anywhere with limited wall space.
A circular wall mirror over your dressing table in the bedroom or your prep counter in the kitchen makes a stylish and practical addition. Even small wall mirrors can have a big impact by creating visual interest while bouncing light off other elements in the room.
Large wall mirrors hung horizontally over couches in the living room—or over a chest of drawers in the bedroom, or dining table in the kitchen—creates a stunning visual impact that enhances how deep and wide a space feels while brightening dark rooms.
Hanging mirrors are great for complementing picture frames in stairwells and hallways as they reflect light and brighten spaces, or placed behind where you typically light a candle. Our medium sizes add functional style when centered over accent tables in bedrooms, living rooms or hallways.
Decorative wall mirrors

Consider your space and the visual impact that you want the wall mirror you select to provide. Do you want a complementary piece that will cast light on neighboring objects or do you want a focal point that will significantly brighten a room while making it appear larger?

Think about the role a given decorative wall mirror will play in shaping ambiance and mood during special dinners, arts & crafts time with the kids or just getting ready for work. 

Where to place a wall mirror?

Position your hanging mirror along the wall where it best captures what you want it to reflect. This might be the full-body laughter that always comes with a big family dinner in the dining room or your styling skills when checking yourself out in an entryway wall mirror before heading to work.

How to hang a wall mirror?

Some wall mirrors can either hang on a wall or be placed on the floor while being anchored and tilted against a wall. Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Be sure to use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.

Monthly Pass

Monthly passes are valid for up to two trips a day (once in each direction) between the stations indicated on your pass for an entire calendar month.

10-Ride Pass

Ten-ride passes are valid for ten rides within a 45-day, 60-day or 90-day period depending on your selected stations. For the Capitol Corridor, ten-ride passes are valid for 60 days.

6-Ride Pass

Six-ride student passes are valid for a 365-day period on Downeaster trains between Boston, MA - North Station and Brunswick, ME and Gold Runner trains between the San Francisco Bay Area/Sacramento and Bakersfield/Southern California.

Amtrak RideReserve

Multi-Ride Pass holders will need to confirm each trip (train and date) through Amtrak.com, the Amtrak app or an Amtrak agent prior to traveling on reserved services; thus, ensuring you have the safest and most comfortable journey possible. Learn more about RideReserve.

RideReserve for Multi-Ride Passes Terms
Amtrak RideReserve confirmations can be made through Amtrak.com, the Amtrak app or an Amtrak Agent.

You can have up to two confirmations per travel day; once in each direction.
You can make confirmations as early as 14 days prior to your departure date or as late as your scheduled departure time through Amtrak.com or the Amtrak app; or until your actual departure time via an Amtrak agent.
RideReserve confirmations initiated on Amtrak.com and the Amtrak app can only be made with an active multi-ride reservation containing a valid email address.
Only required on reserved services.
Seats may not be available on all trains at all times.
Your Multi-Ride Pass does not entitle you to travel without a RideReserve confirmation.
If you don’t use RideReserve to make your confirmation prior to boarding a train, you will be considered an unticketed passenger and current Amtrak Carriage of Passengers terms apply.
Review Ride History

Keep track of remaining rides and your ride history, including the date, time and service used for each trip, for your six- and ten-ride passes on Amtrak.com and in the app. You can also review your pass history by scanning your eTicket at any Amtrak kiosk.


Multi-Ride Passes Are Not Transferable

Multi-Ride Passes may only be used by the passenger whose name is on the pass.

On the Pacific Surfliner only, more than one person may use a ten-ride pass at one time. The person named on the pass must be one of the passengers traveling and all passengers must travel together.

For Which Routes Can I Purchase Passes?

Multi-Ride Passes are available for travel on many routes, but restrictions vary by route, destination and time of day. Multi-Ride Passes may not be used on long-distance trains, certain segments of short-distance trains or Acela trains.

Do I Earn Amtrak Guest Rewards Points? Can I Redeem Them to Purchase a Pass?

Amtrak Guest Rewards members earn 2 points per dollar spent on each Multi-Ride Pass purchase. Points will be added to your account when your pass ends. To redeem points for a Multi Ride Pass, please call us at 1-800-USA-RAIL. Not a member? Join Amtrak Guest Rewards.

How to buy a digital Railcard online with us

Looking to purchase a Railcard? We're here to make the process of securing your next digital Railcard as smooth as possible.

Renew your Railcard

Is it time to renew your digital Railcard? Why not renew it with us – ​just log into your Trainline account and follow our easy steps to get started.

Renew your Railcard

16-17 Saver now valid past age 18
From 17th August 2026, the 16-17 Saver Railcard provides 50% off train travel for a full year from purchase, with the discount valid even after turning 18.
What is a Railcard?

A Railcard is a discount card that allows you to save up to 1/3 off the price of eligible train tickets, making it a great way to secure cheap fares.

What are the different types of UK Railcards?

There are nine different types of UK Railcards available. These are:

Network Railcard
16-17 Saver
16-25 Railcard
26-30 Railcard
Family & Friends Railcard
Two Together Railcard
Senior Railcard
Disabled Persons Railcard
Veterans Railcard

As an official retailer of Railcards from National Rail, you can buy seven of these in a digital format with us.

Please note that the Disabled Persons Railcard and Veterans Railcard are not available to buy with us. We are currently working on the ability to verify eligibility.

How much is a Railcard?
Price: Most Railcards cost just £35 for one year - or only £20 for the Disabled Persons Railcard.
Savings: A Railcard gives you 1/3 off rail fares, helping you travel for less.
Best value: Choose a 3-year Railcard for £80 (equivalent to about £26 per year).
When can you use a Railcard?

Again, this depends on the type of Railcard you have. Generally, all Railcards can be used for discounted train fares during Off-Peak times, weekends and public holidays.

Some, like the age-related Railcards, can be used during Peak times with a minimum fare, and the Disabled Persons Railcard can be used at any time.

Which tickets can you save money on?

It varies depending on the type of Railcard you have, as some are valid for use during Peak times, but generally, as a Railcard holder you can save money on Advance tickets, Off-Peak, Standard, and First Class tickets.

Why should you get a digital Railcard?

Railcard savings add up

Get 1/3 off the price of your train tickets by adding your Railcard discount to your booking. After a few journeys, your digital Railcard could have paid for itself!

There are lots to choose from

Whether you travel regularly with family, partners or friends, or you fit into a specific age group or region, there's a Railcard discount for you.

Railcards and tickets in one place

Digital Railcards live alongside your tickets in our app. Use your digital Railcard on tickets bought anywhere (not just with us).

What our customers say about digital Railcards

Read what our customers have been saying on Trustpilot about Railcards. Got something to say? Leave your feedback on Trustpilot. To find out more about how we collect reviews please visit our customer support page.

Popular journeys booked with Railcards in the UK

How to buy and use your digital Railcard

You'll need to have iOS 15.0 and above or Lollipop on Android to get your digital Railcard on your phone. Don’t have our app yet? Download it now and follow these easy steps to buy your Railcard today with us.

1

Tap 'Buy 1-year for £35' or 'Buy 3-year for £80' (if applicable) to get the Railcard you want on your phone

2

Enter your first and last name (and date of birth if you need to prove your age)

3

Upload a digital passport-style photo for your Railcard from your phone

4

Sign in to your Trainline account on the app and buy your digital Railcard

5

You’ll find your new Railcard under 'Railcards' in the Account tab of the app. Please make sure you're signed into the app with the same account you used to buy your Railcard

6

Enter your departure and arrival station, select the start date of your ticket and the number of people travelling, then select your new Railcard from the drop-down menu – the 1/3 savings will be applied automatically to your booking.

Get more for your money with a 3-year Railcard

You can enjoy even better savings if you opt for a 3-year Railcard, especially if you plan to do a lot of travelling over the next 3 years. Plus, you won’t have to worry about renewing your Railcard every year after it expires.

The 16-25, Senior, Family & Friends and Veterans Railcards are available as a three-year option for £80, meaning you can save £25 on the cost of three individual Railcards. The Disabled Persons Railcard also has a three-year option but it’s cheaper and costs just £54.

 

What is a digital Railcard?

Digital Railcards are stored within the Trainline app on your smartphone or tablet, meaning there's no need to carry the physical card around with you. They can be stored on any compatible device you travel with – there’s no limit on the number of devices you can have your digital Railcard on – and they can be used quicker than paper Railcards as they do not need to be sent in the post.

The minimum Operating System (OS) your Railcard would be available on is iOS 15.0 and above or Lollipop on Android. There are no device limits or download codes needed.

How do I use a digital Railcard?

Once you’ve bought a digital Railcard online with us, follow these easy steps to use it:

When searching for tickets on our website or in our app, tap ‘add a Railcard’ and scroll down to select the type of Railcard you’ve bought from the list
We'll automatically apply your Railcard savings and show you the discounted price
Book your train tickets as a digital ticket, or to be collected at the station
Bring the device your digital Railcard and train tickets are stored on to show to a ticket inspector if asked
How do I get a digital Railcard?

Digital Railcards can be bought online only – use our Railcard recommender at the top of the page to find the best type of Railcard that suits your needs. Once you have chosen your Railcard, simply tap the ‘Buy’ button and follow the instructions on the screen to get your digital Railcard.

How long does it take to receive a digital Railcard?

Your digital Railcard will automatically appear in your app straight after you have bought it. All you need to do is sign into your app to view your Railcard. 

Can I use my digital Railcard without internet?

Yes. Your digital Railcard works offline. It's stored in the app, so you can show it to staff or validators even without a data connection or signal.

What happens if my phone runs out of battery and I can't show my digital Railcard?

You won’t be able to show your digital Railcard. Please make sure your phone is sufficiently charged before travelling so you can show your Railcard when needed. If you’re unable to show a valid Railcard, you may be asked to buy a single ticket or could be issued a Penalty Fare.

Why get a digital Railcard?

Never forget your Railcard again. With the Trainline app, your tickets and Railcards are all in one place. No more switching between apps or digging around for your paper Railcard. There's no need to queue at the ticket office of your local station to purchase one either, simply follow the steps in our app.

 

Railcards secure
on all your devices

Digital Railcards are added to your Trainline account, so you can access them on any compatible device you travel with. Please be aware that the minimum Operating System (OS) your Railcard would be available on is iOS 15.0 and above or Lollipop on Android. There are no device limits or download codes needed.

Stress-free travel

With Trainline, you know you have everything you need to travel. See the ticket inspector coming? Don't stress, your digital Railcard is right where it needs to be, one tap from your ticket**.​ Sound good? If the expiry date on your current Railcard is coming up, why not renew your Railcard with us and start enjoying stress-free train travel today.

I save 1/3 on my train tickets with my 26-30 Digital Railcard

From September, I've been commuting from Chelmsford three times a week since the office opened. Having that in mind during summer, I knew that I had to find a way to save on my travel expenses. The easiest way to do that was to buy the one-year 26-30 digital Railcard.

The last two months I have saved 1/3 out of every train journey I took. Also, I forgot to mention that because I love English nature, I always find time to travel somewhere with my friends and family during the weekends. With that in mind, I think getting a digital railcard was a very smart idea for me and my wallet.

Last but certainly not least for me is that having a digital railcard is very useful as I am not going to forget it, since it is always with me!

Overview

The A6 is the middle child in Audi’s sedan lineup, doing battle against the BMW 5 Series, Cadillac CTS, Jaguar XF, Genesis G80, Lexus GS, and Mercedes-Benz E-Class. It was all-new last year and gets light updates this year.

Audi offers its 45 TFSI and 55 TFSI powertrains in the A6. The first features a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline 4-cylinder engine with 248 horsepower and 273 pound-feet of torque. The second is a turbocharged 3.0-liter V6 engine with 335 hp and 369 lb-ft. Both come with a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission (DCT), “quattro” all-wheel drive (AWD), and mild-hybrid electric vehicle (MHEV) technology. Fuel economy for the A6 is 24 mpg city, 32 highway, and 27 combined for the 45 TFSI setup, or 22, 29, and 24 with the 55 TFSI.

You can select from Premium, Premium Plus, and Prestige trims on the A6. The Premium comes with 19-inch wheels, an 8.8-inch infotainment system, navigation, heated front seats, LED lights, dual-zone automatic climate control, contrast stitching, and heated power-folding exterior mirrors.

The Premium Plus comes with matrix-design LED headlights, a Bang & Olufsen sound system, a full LCD instrument cluster, a heated steering wheel, and a 10.1-inch infotainment system with navigation. A new Executive package lets you tack on 4-zone automatic climate control, heated rear seats, ventilated front seats, a power open/close trunk, and multicolored ambient lighting.

Finally, the Prestige gets everything from the Executive package, along with 12-way power seats.

Every A6 now comes with forward-collision warning, automatic emergency braking, automatic high-beams, and lane-departure warning as well as heated, auto-dimming, and power-folding exterior mirrors. The Prestige grade gets a standard driver-assistance package that bundles adaptive cruise control, traffic-sign recognition, active lane assist with emergency crash evasion, and intersection assist. The 2020 A6 received a 2019 Top Safety Pick+ award from the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS).

AeroAPI® is a simple and cost-effective query-based API that delivers data on demand from millions of flight status inputs. With over 60 distinct endpoints, you can customize your data delivery to meet your needs.

Flight information. On demand. On your budget.
With our usage-based pricing model, you can access accurate and precise aviation data, current and historical. Request data as needed for full control over total cost. You can even set up alerts to be notified of the information you need in real time.

Why AeroAPI?
Easy to integrate
Modern REST-based API that is compatible with all programming languages.
Access to historical data
With data stretching back to 2011, post-flight analysis has never been easier.

Customized approach

Foresight harnesses robust historical and real-time aviation data, weather data, and advanced ML to deliver powerful, predictive insights that optimize operations and anticipate risk across nearly every flight on the planet.

Set an alert, get an alert.

Questions & Answers
Is global flight data available?
FlightAware tracks flights globally, all of which are available through AeroAPI.
How do I know how much using AeroAPI will cost me?
It is a usage-based API. You pay only for what you need, on demand. Each query is charged individually. For queries that may return multiple pages of results (a page is defined as up to 15 records), you will be charged for the total number of pages returned (calculated as the per-query fee times the number of pages returned). You can control the maximum number of pages returned by the API for one query. Please refer to the API documentation for details on how to set the "max_pages" parameter.
How can I view my AeroAPI billing status?
Existing customers can view accrued charges in the AeroAPI portal.
Are there any new features?

Greetings from Agoda! We understand that sometimes you need a helping hand to ensure your travel plans run smoothly. That’s why our customer service team is here to assist you every step of the way. On this page, we aim to provide you with all the relevant information on how to reach out to us for any assistance you might need.

Get in Touch Effortlessly

Looking for an Agoda phone number or an Agoda email? We have revolutionized the way you get in touch with us. Instead of searching for an Agoda number or Agoda email, we offer streamlined communication channels designed to handle your queries more efficiently. Our goal is to provide you with quick, reliable answers and solutions without the wait times commonly associated with call centers and email responses.

Seamless Assistance at Your Fingertips

Our dedicated Agoda customer service team is ready to assist you 24/7 through our messaging platform. This direct line of communication allows for real-time assistance, ensuring that your inquiries about bookings, payments, refunds, or any travel-related concerns are addressed promptly. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’ve made sure that reaching out to Agoda's CS is easier than ever.

Navigating Customer Support

For those wondering how to call Agoda or are looking for an Agoda CS number or Agoda email, we encourage you to utilize our user-friendly messaging feature. This contact method allows us to provide personalized support and efficiently resolve your issues. Whether it’s adjusting a reservation or seeking travel advice, our team has the expertise to guide you seamlessly through your queries.

Beyond Calls: Comprehensive Support

Agoda’s helpline extends beyond traditional phone calls or email. Our comprehensive support system includes FAQs, detailed guides, and a robust help center designed to offer immediate answers to common questions. This means that most of the information you need, including how to contact Agoda directly, can be found with just a few clicks.

We’re Here to Help

At Agoda, your satisfaction is our top priority. Whether you’re facing a challenge or simply have a question, do not hesitate to reach out. While you may be searching for an Agoda hotline, Agoda CS number or Agoda email, we invite you to discover the convenience of our messaging service. With Agoda, help is never too far away. Remember, no matter where your travels take you, Agoda’s customer service team is here to ensure your journey is as smooth as possible. Reach out today, and let us help you make the most of your travel experiences.

A Step-by-Step Guide to Accessing Agoda’s Customer Service

In a digital age where convenience and speed are paramount, Agoda has optimized its customer service to be as efficient and user-friendly as possible. If you’ve been trying to find out how to call Agoda or the specific Agoda hotline number or Agoda email, you might be pleasantly surprised to learn that getting the help you need can be much faster and more straightforward. Here is a simple guide on reaching out for support without the need for an Agoda phone number or email.

First Steps to Instant Support

Visit the Agoda Website or App: Start by logging into your Agoda account on either the website or mobile app. This is your gateway to a range of self-service options and support features.
Navigate to the Help Center: Agoda’s Help Center is designed to provide instant answers to a myriad of questions. From managing bookings to understanding payment options, you might find that your query is already answered in our comprehensive FAQs.
Use the Messaging Feature: If your question isn’t answered in the Help Center, or you need personalized assistance, the messaging feature is your next stop. Accessible directly through the Agoda app or website, this feature connects you with our customer service team in real-time.

Why Choose Messaging Over a Call or Email?

No Wait Times: Unlike traditional phone support where you might experience wait times, messaging gets you directly in touch with our customer service team.
24/7 Availability: Agoda’s messaging support is available round the clock, ensuring you receive help when you need it, regardless of time zones.
Track Your Query: With messaging, you can easily track your conversation history, making it simpler to follow up or reference past inquiries.

Advanced Support When You Need It

In those rare instances where your concern requires specialist intervention, our customer service team can escalate your query within our internal systems to ensure you receive precise and expedient assistance. This streamlined process means that even without a traditional Agoda CS number or email, you receive tailored support that addresses your specific needs effectively.

Agoda values your feedback. Each interaction offers us insights into how we can improve our services. So, even in the absence of a direct Agoda phone number or Agoda email, rest assured that your voice is heard, and your feedback contributes to our continual improvement. In sum, the next time you find yourself looking for an Agoda number or email, remember that our customer service is just a few clicks away, promising a hassle-free and efficient solution to your queries.

Buy
Apple Watch Ultra 4

A BATTERY YOU
CAN’T OUTRUN.

Buy

Lease from $24.99/mo. for 24 mo. with Apple Upgrade◊

Comprehensive features

The longest battery life of any Apple Watch. Now with up to 45 hours of Max Extended Workout tracking.1

All-new Health Sensing System delivers the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable.2

Take a closer look.
Advanced Health and Fitness Tracking

Run with all your heart.

Apple Watch Ultra was designed to be the ultimate running watch, with powerful features that help you train smarter and the most accurate on-device GPS in a sports watch.12 Now Apple Watch Ultra 4 takes it to the next level with game-changing health and fitness tracking to help you elevate your performance. And new extended battery life for workouts to keep you moving toward your goals. Run better, run longer.

Heartcore innovation.

Heart data is fundamental in tracking your overall health and performance. Redesigned with more capable optical and electrical sensors, the all‑new Health Sensing System works with the S11 chip to provide higher-frequency heart monitoring. The updated sensors and larger, more power-efficient green LEDs give you richer heart data for more meaningful insights.

Ready advice. The new readiness experience can help you determine your capacity to take on the day by providing you with one simple score. Your score is determined each morning by analyzing your recent activity, vitals, and sleep — and it adjusts as you go about your day. So whether you’re training for a race or juggling a busy schedule, you can spend your energy on what matters most.

HRV? Check. Heart rate variability, or HRV, is an indicator of how your body responds to stress and recovery. Overtraining or poor sleep can raise your stress and lower your HRV. With the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable,2 Apple Watch Ultra 4 measures HRV as often as every five minutes and takes background heart rate readings every five seconds — the most frequent sensing ever for Apple Watch. And with the updated Heart Rate app and new watch face complications, you can easily view your readings anytime.

60x
more frequent background heart rate readings than Ultra 3
24x
more frequent HRV readings than Ultra 3
Run circles around your data.

Ultra 4 goes the extra mile to ensure that you can precisely track and analyze your running workouts. With real‑time metrics, deeper insights into training and performance, and personalized encouragement, you’ll be motivated to hit your goals like never before.

Advance with advanced metrics. 

Track your progress with metrics like running power and cadence. And if you create a Custom Workout on your watch or iPhone, you can add work and recovery intervals, set a pace for outdoor workouts, and more. You can even get an estimate of your VO2 max after your run.

Monitor your Heart Rate Zones. 

Quickly see your exercise intensity level with Heart Rate Zones, which are automatically calculated and personalized using your health data. You can adjust them manually or set up alerts.

Hit the ground running with the Action button. 

It’s customizable and gives you quick control over a variety of functions, so you can do things like control a workout, move to your next interval, mark a segment, and more. All with extreme precision.

Keep pace with Pacer. 

Set specific time and distance goals with Pacer for a running or outdoor cycle workout, and track whether you’re keeping pace.

Get ahead of yourself with Race Route. 

Race against your best times on your favorite runs. See how far ahead or behind you are and how far you have to go.

Slay in your lane with Automatic Track Detection. 

Ultra 4 automatically detects when you arrive at a track and combines Apple Maps data with precision GPS to deliver the most accurate track running experience. Create a Custom Workout with a warmup period, recovery interval, and more.

Push your progress with enhanced Workout Buddy. 

Get real-time encouragement right when you need it with new insights about your pace, distance, and workout progress. And you can finally leave your iPhone at home — all you need is Apple Watch with cellular or a Wi‑Fi connection.13

Never miss a step with an improved step tracker. 

Whether you’re out for a leisurely stroll with your coffee in the morning or running on a treadmill at night, Ultra 4 gives you a more accurate step count and distance measurements all day long. And now you can more easily check your step count, right from your watch face.

Track your training load. 

Helpful insights from training load show the impact your workouts have on your body over time, so it’s easier to plan when you’re training for your next big event.

Step it up with Strava. 

Track every run, ride, or hike with real-time motivation. Live Segments show your progress against your PRs and Live Elevation Stats track your climb. Subscribers can also follow Routes hands-free with Off-Route Alerts to stay on track. Your workout data automatically syncs with the Fitness app on iPhone.

Extreme staying power.

With optimized, more efficient workout algorithms, Ultra 4 delivers even longer battery life. While providing up to 50 hours of everyday battery use,7 it now gives you up to 18 hours of standard workout tracking and up to 45 hours of Max Extended Workout tracking — enough time to complete a 100‑mile race.1

Everyday battery

Up to
50 hours
of normal use7

84 hours
in Low Power Mode7

Workout battery

Up to
18 hours
of standard workout tracking1

of Max Extended Workout tracking1
Learn more about Ultra 4 battery life
Boost your performance with a body of metrics.

The more health insights you have, the more empowered you are to take actions that will optimize how you perform. With in-depth clinical validation and FDA-cleared features, Apple Watch Ultra 4 provides a fuller picture of your health, so you can stay informed.

Wake up to your sleep score. 

Sleep quality is influenced by factors such as sleep duration, bedtime consistency, how often you wake up, and time spent in each sleep stage. Sleep score analyzes these factors every night and provides a classification and a score. You’ll see how the score is calculated, so you can understand the quality of your sleep and learn how to make it more restorative.

A new read on HRV. 

Now you can better understand insights on stress and recovery with HRV in the Vitals app.14 HRV is sampled as often as every five minutes, both during the day and night.

Track and understand changes in your cycle. 

Cycle Tracking is with you through every stage of your menstrual health journey. Log your cycle and get predictions for your period, fertile window, and retrospective ovulation estimates. Cycle Tracking can notify you when your cycle patterns are suggestive of perimenopause as well as provide support during menopause.15

Follow your heart more frequently. 

Ultra 4 uses high-frequency heart rate tracking to monitor your background heart rate, even when you’re not working out, and surfaces a value every five seconds in a new watch face complication.

Measure your blood oxygen. It’s a breathtaking innovation. 

The Health app on iPhone uses data from the sensor in Apple Watch to enable you to take on-demand readings of your blood oxygen as well as background readings, day and night.16

Receive hypertension notifications. 

Ultra 4 can notify you if it identifies patterns of hypertension.17 How? The optical sensor provides data to an algorithm that can detect potential hypertension by analyzing how your blood vessels respond to beats of the heart over 30‑day periods.

Take an ECG anytime, anywhere. 

Check for signs of an irregular heart rhythm, also known as atrial fibrillation, by using the ECG app to generate a single-lead electrocardiogram. You can share your ECG reading with your healthcare provider.18

Heart this app. 

Check your heart rate at any time with the Heart Rate app. And get notifications of a high or low heart rate or an irregular rhythm.19

Coming late 2026
Redesigned Health app. Your present and future. On tap.

With Apple Intelligence at its core, the redesigned Health app transforms your health and fitness data into proactive insights delivering a whole new view of your health — today and over time.3 Featuring groundbreaking privacy protections, your personalized hub securely brings together data from your Apple Watch and synced medical records. And since the Health app adapts to you, you’ll get a real-time read on your health and longevity.

Wearable AI Assistant

Say hello to Siri AI.

With all-new Siri AI, Apple Watch Ultra 4 can tap into broad world knowledge and your personal context to be even more helpful.4 Using just your voice, you can engage in natural, back-and-forth conversations, brainstorm ideas for workout routines, and get the latest wellness tips with Siri — all from your wrist. And now Audio Intelligence uses the built-in microphone and secure S11 chip in Ultra 4, alongside the power of Apple Intelligence, to make sense of what you hear in a private and secure way.5 Just as Visual Intelligence on iPhone helps you make sense of what you see.

Siri AI is available in English.

Revisit conversations in the Siri app. 

Ask Siri a question on your iPhone or any other Apple device synced with iCloud, and pick up where you left off on your Apple Watch. Pin conversations and see the same content, including images, across your devices. Here’s to a little more conversation and a lot more Siri.

Siri Recap can summarize your chats to refresh your memory. 

Siri Recap transforms your conversations into high-level notes, so you can stay focused and present. Each Siri Recap includes a title, a summary, and key points that you can review in the Siri app on your Apple Watch or iPhone. You can turn Siri Recap on or off at any time from Control Center or choose where and when it takes notes, such as only at work or never at night.5

Live Rewind catches what you missed. 

Did someone say something you couldn’t hear in a loud restaurant or share cooking instructions you didn’t quite catch? Just double-click the Digital Crown, and Live Rewind transcribes what was said in the last 15 seconds. You can ask Siri about the content of the transcript or save it to the new Siri app to revisit later.5

Live Rewind coming in beta late 2026.
Usage limits may apply.

Sound Recognition notifies you when it detects important sounds. 

Designed for those who are Deaf or hard of hearing, Sound Recognition can listen for sounds you don’t want to miss, like sirens, alarms, doorbells, or a crying baby. You’ll be alerted with a notification on your watch — even when your iPhone isn’t nearby.20

Shazam can now automatically tell you what song is playing. 

Shazam can instantly detect the music playing around you and automatically display the song title and artist’s name on the Music Recognition widget in the Smart Stack — all without a tap. You can also see the song info when you use the Shazam app or Siri. Talk about music to your ears.21

Great powers come with great privacy.

Made possible by the new S11 chip, Audio Intelligence features are designed to protect your privacy and security at every step. These features do not create or store audio recordings, and raw audio used for processing is completely inaccessible, even to Apple, and is deleted after processing. There is no speaker attribution, and your Live Rewind transcripts and Siri Recaps in the Siri app are end-to-end encrypted through iCloud syncing. You decide whether to opt in to these features, and you control how you use them.5

More Sports

Ultraversatile.

Apple Watch Ultra 4 ups your game in every sport. When you’re cycling, it actively monitors your speed and efficiency so you can see your progress in real time. And in the water, it can track your sets as you swim, automatically detect stroke patterns, and calculate your total distance. Time to clock your best.

Master the Multisport workout. 

Ultra 4 can recognize when you transition between swimming, cycling, and running — and record your metrics for each. Tracking your segments for a triathlon has never been easier.

Watch your cycling metrics on your iPhone. 

When you start a cycling workout on Ultra 4, it automatically shows up as a Live Activity on your iPhone — making it easier to see and safer when it’s mounted on your handlebars.

Find your Power Zones. 

Connect your personal power meter to Ultra 4 to estimate your Functional Threshold Power (FTP), the highest level of intensity theoretically maintainable for an hour. Your FTP enables Power Zones to show your current power, time in a zone, and average power.

Crank it up with Workout Views. 

Want to check your current speed as you ride? Workout Views put your chosen metrics front and center so they’re easy to track. And it’s simple to switch between metrics like Heart Rate Zones, splits, and elevation by turning the Digital Crown.

Strength training. Easy flex. 

The Workout app features extensive strength training capabilities, so you can more accurately track your bench press and barbell lift workouts. Making light work of your heavy lifting.

Make a splash with swim stroke. 

When you’re in a pool, Ultra 4 automatically detects your swim stroke, calculates auto sets with distance and pace, and provides advanced metrics like SWOLF to measure efficiency.

Know what’s Up Next. 

For any Custom Workout you create, the Up Next view allows you to see what’s remaining in your current interval and what you’ll be tackling next. Pro moves.

Adventure

Geared to go farther.

Hiking to new heights and diving to new depths requires specialized tools. Apple Watch Ultra 4 has pioneering features like a powerful compass and a full dive computer, so you can pack light and still be equipped for every expedition.

Retrace your steps with Backtrack. 

To get back on route, Backtrack uses GPS data to automatically create a path of where you’ve been when you’re off grid. You can easily add waypoints for locations, like trailheads or campsites.

Aim higher with a Hiking workout. 

Ultra 4 has a Hiking workout that lets you track your pace, distance, elevation gain, and calories burned. See how high you’ve climbed in real time, and get your total elevation gain when you’re finished. Sky’s the limit.

Blaze a trail with custom routes. 

Create and save custom walking and hiking routes on your iPhone. Choose from different route options: One way, out and back, or a loop — even get turn-by-turn directions — right from your wrist.

Download offline maps. 

Plan ahead and download a map of where you’ll be hiking on your iPhone. It will automatically sync to your watch, so you’ll know where to go, even when you don’t.22

Create waypoints in the Compass app. 

Mark your current location or drop one on a trailhead or campsite. Cellular and emergency call waypoints automatically mark your most recent location within your available networks.

Go deeper with full dive capabilities. 

The Oceanic+ app from Huish Outdoors and other apps turn Ultra 4 into a fully capable dive computer.23 Turn the Digital Crown to get useful data at a glance. Equipped with all the safety warnings you’d expect, the app constantly calculates and monitors your dive parameters.

Get the Oceanic+ app
Let the Tides app guide you. 

Get seven days of estimated information including rising, falling, high, and low tides, sunrise, and sunset. Check conditions at shorelines around the world, or search over 115,000 beaches by name.

On the Go

Connected. Protected.

Now when you’re off the grid without cellular or Wi-Fi, Ultra 4 can help you stay connected using built-in satellite communications. So wherever adventure takes you, you can still keep in touch with loved ones. And if you need critical help, you can contact emergency services via satellite — right from your wrist. Packed with innovative safety firsts, Apple Watch Ultra 4 has your back. It’s designed to summon help when you need it most — even if you can’t reach your iPhone.24

Get help with Emergency SOS via satellite. 

With a few simple taps, Ultra 4 can gather critical information, connect you to a satellite, and reach out to emergency services, so you can get the assistance you need as quickly as possible.25

Fall Detection at the ready. 

If Ultra 4 detects that you’ve taken a hard fall, it can automatically help connect you with emergency services, provide dispatchers with your location, and notify loved ones.25

Crash Detection. Your guardian on the go. 

If you’ve been in a severe car crash, Ultra 4 can automatically help call emergency services, share your location, and notify your emergency contacts.25

Activate a siren. 

If you need to attract attention when you’re lost or injured, hold down the Action button to activate a siren that can be heard up to 600 feet or 180 meters away.

Stay connected and safe with Messages. 

Use Messages via satellite to stay in touch or contact emergency services wherever you are. You can also send and receive texts, emoji, and Tapbacks via iMessage or use SMS.24

Be found with Find My. 

Use Find My to share your location via satellite so friends and family know where you are. Before you go off grid, add the contacts you plan to share your location with using your paired iPhone or Ultra 4.24

Let there be flashlight. 

Illuminate nearby objects, alert others when you’re running at night, or shine a light in a campsite. You can also customize the Action button to control it.

Set up your Medical ID. 

In an emergency, first responders are able to quickly access critical medical information — like allergies or medications — directly from your Ultra 4.

All you need is your watch. 

With Apple Watch Ultra 4, you can keep in touch with the people and things that matter most no matter where you are.26 Superfast 5G capability lets you text, talk, download apps, stream music or podcasts, and work out on the go.27

All-day battery life testing includes: 300 time checks, 90 notifications, 15 minutes of app use, a 60-minute workout with music playback from Apple Watch via Bluetooth, and 6 hours of sleep tracking over the course of 24 hours; Apple Watch Series 12 (GPS) usage includes connection to iPhone via Bluetooth during the entire 24-hour test; Apple Watch Series 12 (GPS + Cellular) usage includes a total of 4 hours of cellular connection and 20 hours of connection to iPhone via Bluetooth over the course of 24 hours. Battery life testing in Low Power Mode includes: 530 time checks, 160 notifications, 26 minutes of app use, a 60-minute workout with music playback from Apple Watch via Bluetooth, and 6 hours of sleep tracking over the course of 38 hours; Apple Watch Series 12 (GPS) usage includes connection to iPhone via Bluetooth during the entire 38-hour test; Apple Watch Series 12 (GPS + Cellular) usage includes on-demand cellular connection and 30 hours of connection to iPhone via Bluetooth over the course of 38 hours. Testing conducted by Apple in July and August 2026 using preproduction Apple Watch Series 12 (GPS) and Apple Watch Series 12 (GPS + Cellular), each paired with an iPhone; all devices tested with prerelease software. Battery life varies by use, configuration, cellular network, signal strength, and many other factors; actual results will vary.
Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch SE 3 require iPhone 11 or later with iOS 27 or later.

Comprehensive features

The longest battery life of any Apple Watch. Now with up to 45 hours of Max Extended Workout tracking.1

All-new Health Sensing System delivers the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable.2

Take a closer look.
Advanced Health and Fitness Tracking

Run with all your heart.

Apple Watch Ultra was designed to be the ultimate running watch, with powerful features that help you train smarter and the most accurate on-device GPS in a sports watch.12 Now Apple Watch Ultra 4 takes it to the next level with game-changing health and fitness tracking to help you elevate your performance. And new extended battery life for workouts to keep you moving toward your goals. Run better, run longer.

Heartcore innovation.

Heart data is fundamental in tracking your overall health and performance. Redesigned with more capable optical and electrical sensors, the all‑new Health Sensing System works with the S11 chip to provide higher-frequency heart monitoring. The updated sensors and larger, more power-efficient green LEDs give you richer heart data for more meaningful insights.

Ready advice. The new readiness experience can help you determine your capacity to take on the day by providing you with one simple score. Your score is determined each morning by analyzing your recent activity, vitals, and sleep — and it adjusts as you go about your day. So whether you’re training for a race or juggling a busy schedule, you can spend your energy on what matters most.

HRV? Check. Heart rate variability, or HRV, is an indicator of how your body responds to stress and recovery. Overtraining or poor sleep can raise your stress and lower your HRV. With the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable,2 Apple Watch Ultra 4 measures HRV as often as every five minutes and takes background heart rate readings every five seconds — the most frequent sensing ever for Apple Watch. And with the updated Heart Rate app and new watch face complications, you can easily view your readings anytime.

60x
more frequent background heart rate readings than Ultra 3
24x
more frequent HRV readings than Ultra 3
Run circles around your data.

Ultra 4 goes the extra mile to ensure that you can precisely track and analyze your running workouts. With real‑time metrics, deeper insights into training and performance, and personalized encouragement, you’ll be motivated to hit your goals like never before.

Advance with advanced metrics. 

Track your progress with metrics like running power and cadence. And if you create a Custom Workout on your watch or iPhone, you can add work and recovery intervals, set a pace for outdoor workouts, and more. You can even get an estimate of your VO2 max after your run.

Monitor your Heart Rate Zones. 

Quickly see your exercise intensity level with Heart Rate Zones, which are automatically calculated and personalized using your health data. You can adjust them manually or set up alerts.

Hit the ground running with the Action button. 

It’s customizable and gives you quick control over a variety of functions, so you can do things like control a workout, move to your next interval, mark a segment, and more. All with extreme precision.

Keep pace with Pacer. 

Set specific time and distance goals with Pacer for a running or outdoor cycle workout, and track whether you’re keeping pace.

Get ahead of yourself with Race Route. 

Race against your best times on your favorite runs. See how far ahead or behind you are and how far you have to go.

Slay in your lane with Automatic Track Detection. 

Ultra 4 automatically detects when you arrive at a track and combines Apple Maps data with precision GPS to deliver the most accurate track running experience. Create a Custom Workout with a warmup period, recovery interval, and more.

Push your progress with enhanced Workout Buddy. 

Get real-time encouragement right when you need it with new insights about your pace, distance, and workout progress. And you can finally leave your iPhone at home — all you need is Apple Watch with cellular or a Wi‑Fi connection.13

Never miss a step with an improved step tracker. 

Whether you’re out for a leisurely stroll with your coffee in the morning or running on a treadmill at night, Ultra 4 gives you a more accurate step count and distance measurements all day long. And now you can more easily check your step count, right from your watch face.

Track your training load. 

Helpful insights from training load show the impact your workouts have on your body over time, so it’s easier to plan when you’re training for your next big event.

Step it up with Strava. 

Track every run, ride, or hike with real-time motivation. Live Segments show your progress against your PRs and Live Elevation Stats track your climb. Subscribers can also follow Routes hands-free with Off-Route Alerts to stay on track. Your workout data automatically syncs with the Fitness app on iPhone.

Extreme staying power.

With optimized, more efficient workout algorithms, Ultra 4 delivers even longer battery life. While providing up to 50 hours of everyday battery use,7 it now gives you up to 18 hours of standard workout tracking and up to 45 hours of Max Extended Workout tracking — enough time to complete a 100‑mile race.1

Boost your performance with a body of metrics.

The more health insights you have, the more empowered you are to take actions that will optimize how you perform. With in-depth clinical validation and FDA-cleared features, Apple Watch Ultra 4 provides a fuller picture of your health, so you can stay informed.

Wake up to your sleep score. 

Sleep quality is influenced by factors such as sleep duration, bedtime consistency, how often you wake up, and time spent in each sleep stage. Sleep score analyzes these factors every night and provides a classification and a score. You’ll see how the score is calculated, so you can understand the quality of your sleep and learn how to make it more restorative.

A new read on HRV. 

Now you can better understand insights on stress and recovery with HRV in the Vitals app.14 HRV is sampled as often as every five minutes, both during the day and night.

Track and understand changes in your cycle. 

Cycle Tracking is with you through every stage of your menstrual health journey. Log your cycle and get predictions for your period, fertile window, and retrospective ovulation estimates. Cycle Tracking can notify you when your cycle patterns are suggestive of perimenopause as well as provide support during menopause.15

Follow your heart more frequently. 

Ultra 4 uses high-frequency heart rate tracking to monitor your background heart rate, even when you’re not working out, and surfaces a value every five seconds in a new watch face complication.

Measure your blood oxygen. It’s a breathtaking innovation. 

The Health app on iPhone uses data from the sensor in Apple Watch to enable you to take on-demand readings of your blood oxygen as well as background readings, day and night.16

Receive hypertension notifications. 

Ultra 4 can notify you if it identifies patterns of hypertension.17 How? The optical sensor provides data to an algorithm that can detect potential hypertension by analyzing how your blood vessels respond to beats of the heart over 30‑day periods.

Take an ECG anytime, anywhere. 

Check for signs of an irregular heart rhythm, also known as atrial fibrillation, by using the ECG app to generate a single-lead electrocardiogram. You can share your ECG reading with your healthcare provider.18

Heart this app. 

Check your heart rate at any time with the Heart Rate app. And get notifications of a high or low heart rate or an irregular rhythm.19

Coming late 2026
Redesigned Health app. Your present and future. On tap.

With Apple Intelligence at its core, the redesigned Health app transforms your health and fitness data into proactive insights delivering a whole new view of your health — today and over time.3 Featuring groundbreaking privacy protections, your personalized hub securely brings together data from your Apple Watch and synced medical records. And since the Health app adapts to you, you’ll get a real-time read on your health and longevity.

Insights
Health Age
Longevity
Personalized guidance

Tap into the Insights tab for a quick look at daily metrics and trends in your heart, sleep, fitness, vitals, readiness, and cycle tracking. Apple Intelligence makes sense of your daily habits and offers personalized guidance, like tips on how to improve your sleep routine.4 It’s all about you — right here, right now.

Wearable AI Assistant

Say hello to Siri AI.

With all-new Siri AI, Apple Watch Ultra 4 can tap into broad world knowledge and your personal context to be even more helpful.4 Using just your voice, you can engage in natural, back-and-forth conversations, brainstorm ideas for workout routines, and get the latest wellness tips with Siri — all from your wrist. And now Audio Intelligence uses the built-in microphone and secure S11 chip in Ultra 4, alongside the power of Apple Intelligence, to make sense of what you hear in a private and secure way.5 Just as Visual Intelligence on iPhone helps you make sense of what you see.

Siri AI is available in English.
Some Audio Intelligence features coming in beta late 2026.
Usage limits may apply.

Revisit conversations in the Siri app. 

Ask Siri a question on your iPhone or any other Apple device synced with iCloud, and pick up where you left off on your Apple Watch. Pin conversations and see the same content, including images, across your devices. Here’s to a little more conversation and a lot more Siri.

Siri Recap can summarize your chats to refresh your memory. 

Siri Recap transforms your conversations into high-level notes, so you can stay focused and present. Each Siri Recap includes a title, a summary, and key points that you can review in the Siri app on your Apple Watch or iPhone. You can turn Siri Recap on or off at any time from Control Center or choose where and when it takes notes, such as only at work or never at night.5

Siri Recap coming in beta late 2026.
Usage limits may apply.

Live Rewind catches what you missed. 

Did someone say something you couldn’t hear in a loud restaurant or share cooking instructions you didn’t quite catch? Just double-click the Digital Crown, and Live Rewind transcribes what was said in the last 15 seconds. You can ask Siri about the content of the transcript or save it to the new Siri app to revisit later.5

Live Rewind coming in beta late 2026.
Usage limits may apply.

Sound Recognition notifies you when it detects important sounds. 

Designed for those who are Deaf or hard of hearing, Sound Recognition can listen for sounds you don’t want to miss, like sirens, alarms, doorbells, or a crying baby. You’ll be alerted with a notification on your watch — even when your iPhone isn’t nearby.20

Shazam can now automatically tell you what song is playing. 

Shazam can instantly detect the music playing around you and automatically display the song title and artist’s name on the Music Recognition widget in the Smart Stack — all without a tap. You can also see the song info when you use the Shazam app or Siri. Talk about music to your ears.21

Great powers come with great privacy.

Made possible by the new S11 chip, Audio Intelligence features are designed to protect your privacy and security at every step. These features do not create or store audio recordings, and raw audio used for processing is completely inaccessible, even to Apple, and is deleted after processing. There is no speaker attribution, and your Live Rewind transcripts and Siri Recaps in the Siri app are end-to-end encrypted through iCloud syncing. You decide whether to opt in to these features, and you control how you use them.5

Learn more about our approach to privacy with Audio Intelligence (PDF)
, opens in a new tab
More Sports

Ultraversatile.

Apple Watch Ultra 4 ups your game in every sport. When you’re cycling, it actively monitors your speed and efficiency so you can see your progress in real time. And in the water, it can track your sets as you swim, automatically detect stroke patterns, and calculate your total distance. Time to clock your best.

Master the Multisport workout. 

Ultra 4 can recognize when you transition between swimming, cycling, and running — and record your metrics for each. Tracking your segments for a triathlon has never been easier.

Watch your cycling metrics on your iPhone. 

When you start a cycling workout on Ultra 4, it automatically shows up as a Live Activity on your iPhone — making it easier to see and safer when it’s mounted on your handlebars.

Find your Power Zones. 

Connect your personal power meter to Ultra 4 to estimate your Functional Threshold Power (FTP), the highest level of intensity theoretically maintainable for an hour. Your FTP enables Power Zones to show your current power, time in a zone, and average power.

Crank it up with Workout Views. 

Want to check your current speed as you ride? Workout Views put your chosen metrics front and center so they’re easy to track. And it’s simple to switch between metrics like Heart Rate Zones, splits, and elevation by turning the Digital Crown.

Strength training. Easy flex. 

The Workout app features extensive strength training capabilities, so you can more accurately track your bench press and barbell lift workouts. Making light work of your heavy lifting.

Make a splash with swim stroke. 

When you’re in a pool, Ultra 4 automatically detects your swim stroke, calculates auto sets with distance and pace, and provides advanced metrics like SWOLF to measure efficiency.

Know what’s Up Next. 

For any Custom Workout you create, the Up Next view allows you to see what’s remaining in your current interval and what you’ll be tackling next. Pro moves.

Adventure

Geared to go farther.

Hiking to new heights and diving to new depths requires specialized tools. Apple Watch Ultra 4 has pioneering features like a powerful compass and a full dive computer, so you can pack light and still be equipped for every expedition.

Retrace your steps with Backtrack. 

To get back on route, Backtrack uses GPS data to automatically create a path of where you’ve been when you’re off grid. You can easily add waypoints for locations, like trailheads or campsites.

Aim higher with a Hiking workout. 

Ultra 4 has a Hiking workout that lets you track your pace, distance, elevation gain, and calories burned. See how high you’ve climbed in real time, and get your total elevation gain when you’re finished. Sky’s the limit.

Blaze a trail with custom routes. 

Create and save custom walking and hiking routes on your iPhone. Choose from different route options: One way, out and back, or a loop — even get turn-by-turn directions — right from your wrist.

Download offline maps. 

Plan ahead and download a map of where you’ll be hiking on your iPhone. It will automatically sync to your watch, so you’ll know where to go, even when you don’t.22

Create waypoints in the Compass app. 

Mark your current location or drop one on a trailhead or campsite. Cellular and emergency call waypoints automatically mark your most recent location within your available networks.

Go deeper with full dive capabilities. 

The Oceanic+ app from Huish Outdoors and other apps turn Ultra 4 into a fully capable dive computer.23 Turn the Digital Crown to get useful data at a glance. Equipped with all the safety warnings you’d expect, the app constantly calculates and monitors your dive parameters.

Get the Oceanic+ app
Let the Tides app guide you. 

Get seven days of estimated information including rising, falling, high, and low tides, sunrise, and sunset. Check conditions at shorelines around the world, or search over 115,000 beaches by name.

On the Go

Connected. Protected.

Now when you’re off the grid without cellular or Wi-Fi, Ultra 4 can help you stay connected using built-in satellite communications. So wherever adventure takes you, you can still keep in touch with loved ones. And if you need critical help, you can contact emergency services via satellite — right from your wrist. Packed with innovative safety firsts, Apple Watch Ultra 4 has your back. It’s designed to summon help when you need it most — even if you can’t reach your iPhone.24

Get help with Emergency SOS via satellite. 

With a few simple taps, Ultra 4 can gather critical information, connect you to a satellite, and reach out to emergency services, so you can get the assistance you need as quickly as possible.25

Fall Detection at the ready. 

If Ultra 4 detects that you’ve taken a hard fall, it can automatically help connect you with emergency services, provide dispatchers with your location, and notify loved ones.25

Crash Detection. Your guardian on the go. 

If you’ve been in a severe car crash, Ultra 4 can automatically help call emergency services, share your location, and notify your emergency contacts.25

Activate a siren. 

If you need to attract attention when you’re lost or injured, hold down the Action button to activate a siren that can be heard up to 600 feet or 180 meters away.

Stay connected and safe with Messages. 

Use Messages via satellite to stay in touch or contact emergency services wherever you are. You can also send and receive texts, emoji, and Tapbacks via iMessage or use SMS.24

Be found with Find My. 

Use Find My to share your location via satellite so friends and family know where you are. Before you go off grid, add the contacts you plan to share your location with using your paired iPhone or Ultra 4.24

Let there be flashlight. 

Illuminate nearby objects, alert others when you’re running at night, or shine a light in a campsite. You can also customize the Action button to control it.

Set up your Medical ID. 

In an emergency, first responders are able to quickly access critical medical information — like allergies or medications — directly from your Ultra 4.

All you need is your watch. 

With Apple Watch Ultra 4, you can keep in touch with the people and things that matter most no matter where you are.26 Superfast 5G capability lets you text, talk, download apps, stream music or podcasts, and work out on the go.27

Worth the upgrade?
100 percent.

For a 14-inch MacBook Pro 16GB with a purchase price of $1,999 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit), the typical monthly payment is $38.99 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit) for a 36-month lease term and $53.99 (excluding taxes and any trade-in credit) for a 24-month lease term.

You may incur a substantial charge up to the amount of your remaining lease payments if you terminate your lease before the end of your initial lease term. You may have the option to upgrade to a new device by entering into a new lease agreement and returning your prior device. If you upgrade, your new monthly payments may be greater than your prior monthly payments. If you do not upgrade, terminate your lease, or purchase your device by the end of the initial lease term, the lease will convert to a month-to-month lease for up to six months. Your monthly payments may increase during the month-to-month period. If you take no action at the end of your extension period, you will be charged for the amount due to exercise the purchase option under your lease. You will not own your device at the end of your lease unless you pay the amount due to exercise the purchase option. Insurance is not included in your lease, and you may incur damage fees if the device is lost, stolen, or not returned in the condition required by the lease.

Apple Upgrade Lease Eligibility: Leases are only available to U.S. residents (excluding residents of U.S. territories). Leased devices are only available for shipping to U.S. addresses (excluding U.S. territories) or pickup at Apple retail stores in the U.S. (excluding U.S. territories). To be eligible for a lease, you must be at least 18 years old (or the legal age in your state of residence), have a valid Social Security number or individual taxpayer identification number (ITIN), have an accepted credit or debit card, have an Apple Account in good standing, have a Klarna Account, and be able to receive security verification codes via text message. Leases are not available on refurbished accessories or online at the following special stores: Apple Employee Purchase Plan; participating corporate Employee Purchase Programs; Apple at Work for small businesses or enterprises; Government, Education, or Veterans and Military Purchase Programs.

See here for more information about eligible products. Existing customers: See your Customer Agreement for your variable APR. As of October 1, 2026, the variable APR on new Apple Card accounts ranges from 17.74% to 27.99%. You must elect to use ACMI at checkout. If you buy an ACMI‑eligible product with a one-time payment on Apple Card at checkout, that purchase is subject to your Apple Card’s variable APR, not the ACMI 0% APR. Taxes and shipping on items purchased using ACMI are subject to your Apple Card’s variable APR, not the ACMI 0% APR. In order to buy an iPhone with ACMI, you must select one of the following carriers (prepaid carrier plans are not supported): AT&T, T‑Mobile, or Verizon. An iPhone purchased with ACMI is always unlocked, so you can switch carriers at any time, subject to your carrier’s terms. The last month’s payment for each product will be the product’s purchase price, less all other payments at the monthly payment amount. ACMI is subject to change at any time for any reason, including but not limited to installment term lengths and eligible products. See the Apple Card Customer Agreement for more information about ACMI.

To access and use all Apple Card features and products available only to Apple Card users, you must add Apple Card to Wallet on an iPhone or iPad that supports and has the latest version of iOS or iPadOS.
